title: campomanesia schultziana
intro: Campomanesia schultziana, commonly known as Brazilian guava or pitomba, is a plant species belonging to the family Myrtaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Campomanesia schultziana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
